notes: Settings, Home, Rows is two lists now: the catalogs that are not on Home, and Home's rows in order, each with its own filter. Signed in, Settings can show only the settings that stay on this device or only the ones that follow your profile. A title's stream list starts with the stream you played last, and Same as last time keeps to the row you chose yourself and waits for its add-on. The watch party panel can stand beside the picture instead of over it.
